messages:
maya: Kicking off Acme cloud listing preflight. Need final ARM template + GCP service-account/roles + AWS marketplace role mapping. Also confirm whether Acme wants trial auto-provision via marketplace or manual onboarding.

todd: I'll take GCP and AWS role mapping. For GCP do we want a single SA with roles: run.invoker, storage.objectAdmin, compute.viewer? Draft binding below.

ana: Product note: packaging must include two plans (Starter, Enterprise) and a free 14-day trial on Starter. Starter will be SaaS-managed; Enterprise can be reseller/provisioned. Need legal on telemetry consent for trial.

claire-legal: On telemetry: we need explicit opt-in language for telemetry during trial; cannot bundle it in EULA. Draft snippet: "During the trial period, Acme may collect anonymized usage metrics to improve service. Customers can opt out via account settings." Also confirm if reseller/resale language is needed. If Enterprise sales go through partner/reseller, we must add standard reseller flow clause.

maya: Todd, can you drop the GCP binding example here? Also we need an ARM sample for Azure marketplace manifest that includes SaaS plan configuration and redirect URI for provisioning callbacks.

todd: GCP IAM binding (replace PROJECT_ID and SA_EMAIL):
```
- role: roles/run.invoker
  members:
    - serviceAccount:SA_EMAIL
- role: roles/storage.objectAdmin
  members:
    - serviceAccount:SA_EMAIL
- role: roles/compute.viewer
  members:
    - serviceAccount:SA_EMAIL
```
For AWS, recommend a cross-account role with TrustPolicy: "Service": "marketplace.amazonaws.com" and a policy allowing sts:AssumeRole by Redwood publisher role. I'll author and attach to MKP ticket.

maya: Adding Azure ARM snippet for SaaS plan manifest (placeholder values):
```
{
  "type": "Microsoft.Marketplace/offer",
  "name": "acme-offer",
  "properties": {
    "plans": [
      {"planId":"starter","displayName":"Starter","isFreeTrial":true},
      {"planId":"enterprise","displayName":"Enterprise","isFreeTrial":false}
    ],
    "saas":{"provisioning":{"uri":"https://acme.example.com/marketplace/provision","callback":"https://acme.example.com/marketplace/callback"}}
  }
}
```
Replace URIs with Acme endpoints.

ops-bot: ops-bot: created ticket MKP-513 - "Acme marketplace preflight: IAM/KMS/ARM + legal copy" and assigned to @todd/@maya/@ana/@claire-legal. https://boards.internal/issue/MKP-513

ana: UX asks: trial provisioning flow must surface telemetry consent checkbox during redirect. If user declines, fallback to limited telemetry mode and block auto-instrumentation. @claire-legal is that acceptable?

claire-legal: Yes, acceptable. Need copy we will use in UX and a note on where that state is stored (account metadata). Also request for data retention period in the draft (default 90 days for trial telemetry).

maya: Next steps: Todd finalize IAM policies + AWS trust policy; attach sample JSON to MKP-513. Ana finalize packaging copy + UI telemetry consent copy. Claire final EULA + reseller clause decision. We'll do a quick sync 16:00 UTC today to confirm manifests. Ping here if blocked. :rocket:
